release.note: First effective v0.9.4 release, frozen from the owner-approved candidate v0.9.4-mp0-candidate (0.9.4-r1) as 0.9.4-r2: the r2 handoff (DATAVIZ-02, DATAVIZ-03, GATE-01, MOTION-04, MOTIF-01…05, FAVICON-01, SOCIALFMT-01 amendment, EVID-05), the 0.9.3-r2 revision (MOTIF-06) and the board delta 0.9.2-r2 → 0.9.4-r1 (DATAVIZ-04 hue windows, DATAVIZ-03 warm lane + D-STEP-03, DATAVIZ-05 series v7 with the A5.2 ink amendment, V-POLE-01 fix, color-srgb-07). The owner-finalization condition is enforced by OUTPUT-CLARITY-01: unresolved workflow residue blocks public delivery instead of appearing as audience-visible caveats. This package supersedes v0.9.1-mp7 as the effective Design System release; 0.9.4-r2 changes no rule text (provenance-only edits recorded as sentence-ledger stage 5).

color.reason: A governed value change mints a new set id: 26 values of the superseded 0.9.3 candidate's color-srgb-06 change under the board delta (18 scale anchors — warm-lane darks, density.area, age, tradeoff and flow — and 8 series values with slot 10 rose → green); categorical series (v7), analytical scales (14 sequential + 6 diverging; light from proposal r2 + delta, dark derived under the amended DATAVIZ-03 with the declared age exception) and value states differ from color-srgb-05; brand, energy, foundation, semantic, signature, product and map values are byte-identical with color-srgb-05.
color.parity: every channel (registry, production CSS, ext CSS, tokens, DTCG export, showcase) resolves color-srgb-07; color-srgb-06 is never redefined
color.embeddedMetadataPrecedence: The three color-srgb-07 registry files are byte-identical to the approved candidate's so that color-srgb-07 has exactly one byte identity (ship-color-set-with-release-parity); the lifecycle text embedded in them (status candidate, 0.9.4-r1) records their candidate provenance only. release.json is the sole authority for the current release lifecycle and package-validation state.

motion.reason: Adds identity motion (MOTION-04), the motif register (MOTIF-01…05), the measured motif carriers (MOTIF-06) and changes repetition semantics under OWNER-MOTION-01; approach timing, distance and easing values are unchanged.

versionPolicy.dsVersion: Changes only when a normative design-system requirement changes.
versionPolicy.authoringRevision: Changes for editorial corrections that do not alter requirements.
versionPolicy.schemaVersion: Changes when a machine contract, enum, structure, or validation rule changes.
versionPolicy.setId: Changes only when values or semantic ownership in that set change.
versionPolicy.machinePackage: Changes whenever the generated package contents change.
versionPolicy.artifactBuild: Is independent from this release and identifies a particular output build.
versionPolicy.productContentRelease: Is independent from this release and MUST preserve its own evidence boundary.

domainResolution.productFactsCapabilitiesEvidenceAndPermi: owner-approved truth and evidence release of the named product
domainResolution.visualInteractionAccessibilityAndFormat: effective Landometer Design System release and resolved packs
domainResolution.artifactIntentAudienceAndDelivery: approved artifact Build Card within the authorities above
domainResolution.experimentsExamplesAndCandidates: may inform work but cannot override any approved authority

authority.candidateBoundary: Attached proposals, handoffs, audits, benchmarks, examples, and live-site observations are evidence inputs; they are not normative merely because they are included in the source set.
authority.sharedLayer: Portfolio, methodology, and product architecture language MUST remain product-neutral across Land, Location, and Living.
authority.productLayer: Product-specific facts, audiences, sectors, permissions, data, and claims MUST remain inside their named product and evidence boundary.
authority.ownerDecisionPrecedence: OWNER-MOTION-01 outranks every Design System version for repetition; the answers of 2026-09-15 (six-issue round carried forward, and the 0.9.3 round), of 2026-09-16 (motif carriers, which bring the placement ladder approved on 2026-09-11 into the Design System) and of 2026-09-17 (board delta 0.9.2-r2 → 0.9.4-r1, rule numbering, approval, LUT path back to the board) govern this candidate.

humanMachineParity.automaticScope: rule ID, title, acceptance ID, method, required-set, and format-pack structural coverage
humanMachineParity.scope: the owner approved the 0.9.4 candidate text and values on 17 September 2026 (as the v0.9.1 approval of 1 September 2026 was recorded for v0.9.1-mp7); every new or amended rule sentence of 0.9.4 is the board delta verbatim; the freeze changes no rule text. A separate bilingual re-read of the assembled master by the owner is listed under postApprovalFollowUps and is not claimed here.
